objectives.name: the Hollows
objectives.text: Get through the Silt. Don't stop

objectives.name: Meridian Mall
objectives.text: Run the overpass to Meridian Mall

radio.line: Parker! You're in the Silt. Whatever lives down there, don't let it catch you standing.
Crawlers. They're fast over short distances. Keep your speed and they can't keep up.
He climbed out! Folks, nobody climbs out of the Silt. I'm going to need a bigger bridge.
...and the traffic on the overpass is one man, heading west, fast. Drive safe, darling.
Oops. Did that bridge fall down? Bridges are so old these days. Say hi to the Silt for me, Parker.
You're alive. Good. Run. The dust down there isn't the dangerous part.
Up on the overpass. It runs straight to the mall. The mall is the only way across the center.
Meridian Mall, folks! Our arena! Parker, darling, you've just walked into the main event.

bail.line: Face first in the Silt! That'll stain.

combo.line: That's how you outrun them. Don't stop.
He's dancing in the Silt! Somebody give the crawlers a lesson.

down.line: You stopped. Never stop down there.

tape.line: ...the Silt isn't empty. The Hollows were people once. Don't let him tell you otherwise.
